expected.body: A 42-year-old woman with uterine fibroids presents with fatigue, koilonychia, ferritin 4 ng/mL, and TIBC 480 µg/dL. Peripheral smear shows hypochromic microcytic cells. Diagnosis: iron deficiency anemia from chronic blood loss; treat with oral ferrous sulfate. Key teaching: ferritin is the most sensitive early marker; TIBC rises in deficiency, distinguishing it from anemia of chronic disease.
